business_summary: Miahelsa Holdings Corporation engages in the pharmaceutical, nursing care, childcare support, or food businesses in Japan. The company operates dispensing pharmacies and provides home infusion therapy services. It also offers various nursing care services comprising housing, medical care, nursing care, prevention, and daily life support services. In addition, the company operates childcare and child development projects. Further, the company is involved in the wholesale of food ingredients to schools, nursing care facilities, general restaurants, etc.; and operates as a franchisee of the sushi delivery chain run. Miahelsa Holdings Corporation was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.
